summary: Only the no-project state is verified at the UI level (via RightPaneView's separate ComingSoonPane path); the initial-loading, clean-working-tree, and Git-failure states are asserted only against DiffModel's published flags in a unit test, never against DiffPaneView's actual rendered content, so a regression collapsing DiffPaneView.content to always render the populated file list would go undetected.
